name: kesari-courier
description: Kesari Courier Enterprise Logistics & Courier ERP SaaS Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
